name: hcb-dev
description: Personal developer baseline — a connected pipeline from a task or an issue to reviewed, completed work: slicing and building behind one planning gate, local review in one round — Claude's angles and a Codex pass, a security angle on request — its Critical and Important findings checked by an independent verifier and each source's coverage reported, completion by mode (a local merge into the parent, or a change request), the forge's issue tracker and its label set, handing work across sessions, surveying a backlog slice against the code, fanning an epic out to parallel sessions in waves, saying where the work stands in whichever role a session holds, keeping a branch current with a base that moved and reading what it brought, and git cleanup.

batch_model.title: Batch model
batch_model.description: The model a master session starts its batch sessions on, as `claude --model` takes it — an alias or a full model id.

batch_effort.title: Batch effort
batch_effort.description: The effort level a master session starts its batch sessions at.

batches_max.title: Batches at once
batches_max.description: How many sessions may run in one repository's worktrees at the same time — batches and any other; a master session's launch past it waits for one to end.
